description.en:
Akamori Rikuo wants to be an ordinary salaryman, but…
A genius fighter born into a family that's been practicing the ancient killing arts for centuries, Akamori faces obstacles like the Yakuza, other gangsters, and fighters on the path to what he wants.

**Cancellation:** After the death of author Yukinaga Titti, the series was ended in March 2024.
description.fr: Akamori Mitsuo veut être un salarié ordinaire mais... C’est un meurtrier de génie né dans une famille qui pratique l’art ancien de tuer depuis des siècles. Akamori fait face à des obstacles comme Yakuza, des combattants et des gangs sur le chemin qui mène à son besoin.
description.vi: Một seri mới từ tác giả của Rocopon. Akamori Rikuo, con trai thứ 6 và là một võ sĩ thiên tài trong một gia tộc sở hữu môn võ sát nhân gia truyền từ thời xa xưa. Vậy nhưng Rikuo lại muốn được trở thành một anh nhân viên văn phòng bình thường và giờ đây cuộc sống của cậu sẽ bị lũ lưu manh, đám xã hội đen và những tay võ sĩ khác làm đảo lộn không ngừng.

biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 雪永ちっち (Yukinaga Chicchi)

**Additional Sites:**
- [Sub X](https://x.com/yukinagasub)
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/yukinagatitti/)

Compositor for [Aiming to Be the Strongest While Remaining at the Absolute Lowest Level With My Worthless [Escape] Skill ~Where Experience Points Are Limited and I Get a Flood of Skill Points at Level 1, I Gain Access to Unlimited Skills~](https://mangadex.org/title/9a0f7aab-6726-4a74-91a2-3f9213df1f05).

Yukinaga Titti's death was announced in March 2024 ([ANN](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2024-03-25/satsudou-manga-creator-chicchi-yukinaga-dies/.209186)). No cause of death was given, but this followed Yukinaga being accused of harassing and defaming others on social media, including fellow Young Magazine author [Nyannyan Factory](https://mangadex.org/author/d73a6393-bdfc-4574-be92-3cc5bf69231a), in November 2023 ([X](https://x.com/tkzwgrs/status/1727598698195230986)), leading many to believe it was suicide.

**Name In Native Language:** なだいにし
**Other Romanization:** Nadai Nishi
